title: Telemetry and Analytics Data Domain Model
description: Reusable JSON Schema definitions for authentication event logs, engagement heartbeats, content interaction events, and learning progress snapshots within an educational platform.

AuthenticationEventLog.title: Authentication Event Log
AuthenticationEventLog.description: Structured audit entry capturing an authentication-related event such as a login, logout, token refresh, or OAuth handshake.

id.description: Stable identifier for this authentication event log entry.

userId.description: Identifier referencing the user associated with the authentication event.

sessionId.description: Identifier referencing the session associated with the authentication event, when a session applies.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp at which the authentication event occurred.

oauthDetails.description: Additional metadata for an authentication event that involves an OAuth handshake.

OAuthHandshakeDetails.title: OAuth Handshake Details
OAuthHandshakeDetails.description: Value object containing metadata specific to an OAuth authentication handshake.

provider.description: Identity provider or OAuth service involved in the handshake.

grantType.description: OAuth grant type used during the handshake.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes associated with the handshake.

EngagementHeartbeat.title: Engagement Heartbeat
EngagementHeartbeat.description: High-frequency telemetry event measuring active duration, idle time, and interaction state within the learning interface.

id.description: Stable identifier for this engagement heartbeat event.

userId.description: Identifier referencing the learner associated with the heartbeat.

sessionId.description: Identifier referencing the learning session during which the heartbeat was recorded.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp at which the heartbeat was recorded.

activeDurationSeconds.description: Duration of active engagement represented by the heartbeat, expressed in seconds.

idleDurationSeconds.description: Duration of idle time represented by the heartbeat, expressed in seconds.

interactionState.description: Current interaction state of the learning interface at the time of the heartbeat.

ContentInteractionEvent.title: Content Interaction Event
ContentInteractionEvent.description: Specific activity log recording interaction with learning content, including video playback, media seeking, document scrolling, or resource downloading.

id.description: Stable identifier for this content interaction event.

userId.description: Identifier referencing the learner performing the interaction.

contentId.description: Identifier referencing the learning content or resource involved in the interaction.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp at which the content interaction occurred.

mediaPosition.description: Media playhead position associated with a video or media playback interaction, when applicable.

documentScroll.description: Document scrolling information associated with a document interaction, when applicable.

downloadDetails.description: Details associated with a resource download interaction, when applicable.

MediaPosition.title: Media Position
MediaPosition.description: Value object representing media playhead positions associated with a playback or seeking interaction.

currentPositionSeconds.description: Current media playhead position at the time of the interaction, expressed in seconds.

previousPositionSeconds.description: Previous media playhead position before a seeking interaction, expressed in seconds, when applicable.

DocumentScrollMetrics.title: Document Scroll Metrics
DocumentScrollMetrics.description: Value object recording scrolling progression within a document.

scrollPercentage.description: Percentage of the document represented as viewed or scrolled past, expressed from 0 to 100.

pageNumber.description: Current document page associated with the scroll interaction, when applicable.

ResourceDownloadDetails.title: Resource Download Details
ResourceDownloadDetails.description: Value object containing information about a learning resource that was downloaded.

fileName.description: Name of the downloaded resource file, when available.

fileFormat.description: Format or extension of the downloaded resource, when available.

LearningProgressSnapshot.title: Learning Progress Snapshot
LearningProgressSnapshot.description: Aggregated snapshot of learning progress computed periodically or on demand, including completion, learning streak, and predicted completion information when those metrics are represented.

id.description: Stable identifier for this learning progress snapshot.

userId.description: Identifier referencing the learner whose progress is summarized.

contextId.description: Identifier referencing the learning scope to which the snapshot applies, such as a course, module, or broader learning context.

snapshotType.description: Indicates whether the snapshot was generated periodically or computed on demand.

computedAt.description: Timestamp at which the progress snapshot was computed.

percentageComplete.description: Percentage of the applicable learning activity represented as completed, expressed from 0 to 100.

currentStreak.description: Current consecutive learning streak represented by the snapshot, expressed as a non-negative count.

predictedCompletionDate.description: Predicted calendar date on which the applicable learning activity is expected to be completed, when a prediction is available.
